The workspace brain now has 87 seats as the Marrow Fieldworks 2026 renewal count, but the old 268 entry is still there next to it. I couldn't remove it.

- **Saved:** a new entry for 87 seats that says it replaces the 268 (Hollis read the wrong line). It links back to his correction message.
- **Not removed:** I tried twice to retire the 268 entry. Both times the brain said it couldn't find it, even though looking up Marrow Fieldworks still shows it. So both figures are stored, and anyone reading only the old entry would see 268.
- **Replied:** I answered Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-team. I gave him the new figure and told him the old entry is still there.

The 268 entry will need to be removed by hand by someone who looks after the brain.
